text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

SOYMEAL SALE - China bought at least 60,000 tonnes of soybean meal on Wednesday after heavy purchases of soybeans and meal on Tuesday. China had bought at least 200,000 tonnes each of soybeans and soymeal on Tuesday as prices on the Chicago Board of Trade dipped on weather news. Buying interest waned on Wednesday as the orders sent prices back up.

SOYBEAN SALE - The Taichung division of Taiwan's Breakfast Soybean Procurement Association bought a 54,000 tonne shipment of Brazilian or Argentine soybeans from Andre at a tender on Wednesday, traders said. The soybeans were priced at 150 cents over September CBOT futures with shipment slated fro July 26-August 14.

CORN SALE - The Commodity Credit Corp of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it bought 3,870 tonnes of U.S. corn from Cargill Inc for export to Honduras. The corn was priced at $153.14 a tonne, FOB, for shipment between July 21 and August 20.

WHEAT TENDERS - Guyana is tendering on Thursday for 2,300 tonnes of spring wheat, 1,000 tonnes of soft red winter and 3,000 tonnes of hard red winter under the PL-480 program, agents for the buyer said. Shipment was slated for July 4-26.
- The CCC said it was tendering on June 17 for up to 5,080 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for export to Kenya. Shipment was slated for July 1-25.

CORN TENDER - Privatised Egyptian Starch and Glucose said it was seeking 10,000 tonnes +/- 25 percent buyers option of yellow corn of Egyptian, U.S. or Argentinian origin. The firm said the deadline for bids was Thursday June 12.
CORN/BARLEY TENDER - The Cyprus Grain Commission said it invited tenders for 18,000 tonnes of corn and 25,000 tonnes of barley for shipment in July. The tenders close June 17.

VEGOIL AND TALLOW TENDERS - El Salvador seeks 4,500 tonnes prime bleachable summer yellow cottonseed oil in bulk and about 1,000 tonnes of sunflowerseed oil under the PL-480 export program for July 20-August 5 shipment. Offers are to be received by June 16. El Salvador also seeks on June 16 about 1,650 tonnes of tallow and approximately 800 tonnes of top white tallow. Shipment dates were set for July 20-August 5.

RICE TENDER - The Rice Export Corporation of Pakistan invited bids by June 16 for the sale and export of 5,000 tonnes of basmati variety Pak-7 1996/97 (July-June) rice containing seven percent broken.
MARKET TALK - Better yields and quality were expected from this year's U.S. soft red winter wheat crop versus the 1996 crop after crop scouts this week inspected wheat fields from Ohio to Arkansas.
